why: We want AI to lift paperwork off your plate. We want to protect families' privacy and stop errors going out under our name.
who_it_covers: Staff, volunteers, contractors and board members, including on personal accounts used for our work.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot (pilot)
tools.approved_for: Drafting appeals, thank-yous and grant summaries. No protected information.

tools.name: ChatGPT (free or personal accounts)
tools.approved_for: Lesson plans, reading passages, practice questions, translations. No protected information.

tools.name: Canva AI images
tools.approved_for: Images for communications. No protected information.

new_tools: Luis approves any new tool, plugin, AI agent or AI feature in current software, checking where data goes and what our contracts allow. Client data also needs Grace.
allowed_uses: Make lesson plans and reading passages at different levels

needs_approval.use: New tool, plugin or AI feature, including email readers
AI help with county or grant reports

protected_information: Case files (names, addresses, income, immigration status, children, domestic violence, mental health and substance use notes); donor names, giving history, gift notes; student names, scores, grades, attendance; staff HR files; volunteer details. Our county contract and district agreement require this.
off_limits: No AI photos passed off as real families.
People, not AI, write public statements about the news.
check_before_it_goes_out: A person reads all AI output first, checking facts, names, numbers, tone and bias.
Check county and grant report numbers against our records. Whoever sends it owns it.
decisions_about_people: AI never decides emergency fund awards. Caseworkers and supervisors do.
AI never scores intake essays or places students in class levels.
being_open: A thank-you a person signed needs no AI note.
We label AI-made images and teaching materials.
We answer funders honestly about AI, including grant writing.
if_something_goes_wrong: Tell Luis and Grace the same day. For client data, Grace decides if it is a breach under the county contract.
Reporting a mistake is expected, not punished.
who_owns_this: Luis owns this policy. The board approves it and any changes.
Everyone gets an hour of training, not just an email.
open_questions: Do we buy ChatGPT Team, extend Copilot to everyone, or neither?
May AI ever help with case notes, once the county's rules are known?
Should we promise AI won't be used to cut positions?
Is Luis the right policy owner?
